purpose: Frozen manual editorial cases. Structural checks do not establish prose quality or model effectiveness.

cases.provenance: Bounded published-profile excerpt from the authorized 2026-11-09 maintenance case, without identity, employer names or contact data.
cases.request: Edit this About for a hiring reader who should understand how the engineer works with a team. Use ordinary professional language. Preserve the supplied facts and willingness to help. Do not invent an anecdote.
cases.source_text:
I’m a senior backend engineer working with Go and PHP. When a colleague is stuck, I’m happy to get involved and help solve the problem.

I work with Product, Support Operations, frontend and SRE colleagues to turn product workflows into backend services. My part covers service contracts, code and deployment, as well as investigating problems once a system is running.

assessment_key.expected: Assess the help sentence's narrative role separately from its factual support. Connect the willingness to help to the collaboration account without inventing a specific incident. Check procedural duty language in the next paragraph.
must_preserve: Contracts, code, deployment and production diagnosis
must_not: Treat truth as evidence of flow
Require a universal ban on self-description or lists

cases.request: Edit this About for a hiring reader. Keep an already natural passage unchanged when no useful repair is supported. Treat its first-person claims as supplied facts.
cases.source_text: I build backend services in Go and PHP. When a colleague is stuck on an integration, I help trace the request through the services involved. That means checking what each side expects and where a failed call leaves the workflow.

assessment_key.expected: The helping statement develops directly into an integration action. A keep decision is valid; do not flag helpfulness, first person or a topic change merely by category.
must_not: Delete the helping action because the failing case also mentioned help

cases.source_text: Sono uno sviluppatore backend. La mia attività prevede la definizione dei contratti tra servizi, l’implementazione e il rilascio, oltre all’analisi delle anomalie dopo l’avvio. must_not: Lose work scope to obtain a shorter narrative
